agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/aligned_indent.py: the nl() method had an inverted isinstance check causing a TypeError whenever a keyword-string offset was passed (the normal case for reindent_aligned formatting of FROM/JOIN/WHERE/CASE/GROUP BY/etc.). Changed 'offset = -len(offset) if isinstance(offset, int) else offset' to 'offset = -len(offset) if not isinstance(offset, int) else offset'. Verified with manual tests covering basic SELECT, joins, CASE statements, subqueries, and GROUP BY/ORDER BY/UNION - all now format correctly without errors.
